risks.title: Currency Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange rate fluctuations, particularly in Argentina, Turkey, and Brazil, resulting in a $9.3 million foreign exchange loss in 2025

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market with numerous players, which may lead to pricing pressure and market share risks

risks.title: Acquisition-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company completed two major acquisitions in 2025 (Barnes of Colombia and PumpEng), generating $48.9 million in incremental sales, creating integration and synergy risks

risks.title: Pension-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded a pension settlement charge of $54.9 million in 2025, impacting net income by $41.5 million after tax

risks.title: Tariff-Related Risks
